# Fixtures

Unmodified responses from the Energy-Charts API of Fraunhofer ISE (`/price?bzn=DE-LU`), one per case the parser has to
handle: an hourly day before the 15-minute switch, an ordinary quarter-hourly day, both clock-change days and a day
with negative prices.

The data is from Bundesnetzagentur | SMARD.de, licensed
[CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). These files are not covered by the repository's MIT licence.
